basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and avid gamer based in Austin, TX. I work as a software developer and spend most of my evenings and weekends online, exploring gaming forums and tech subreddits. My interests include live streaming, modding games, and listening to podcasts about self-improvement and military strategy. I'm single and often engage in gaming marathons with friends. I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 10 PM to 2 AM CST, when I'm winding down after a coding session.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been tinkering with computers and software since my early teens. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, with a lot of hands-on experience from building custom PCs and coding personal projects. I often seek out new challenges through online courses and forums, particularly focusing on gaming technology and software development.
